source: Google Business Profile of Inspect-All Home Inspections, pulled 2026-10-10 (same numbers as inspectallnc.com/.claude/reviews.json). Update both files together.
note: These reviews belong to the Google profile of Inspect-All Home Inspections, the company behind this site, and are always shown with that attribution. Names are first name + last initial. Text is verbatim from Google. Reviews that mention prices are left out (no prices on the site). The septic-mentioning reviews are listed first.

featured.name: Wanda F.
featured.text: Shannon did a thorough job and had the report available quickly on our septic inspection. We will be using him for the home inspection as well.

featured.name: Marty B.
featured.text: Shannan was awesome! We had quite a few home inspections over the years, and this one was the most thorough. He sincerely cares about giving you the best service possible. I would strongly recommend his business for not only a home inspection but also a septic inspection. Very pleased!

featured.name: Michelle B.
featured.text: Mr. Hurt was very detailed with the home inspection. He took photos as well as made suggestions of who I would need to contact for each issue he found in the house. I was so impressed, I had Mr. Hurt do my septic and radon inspection as well. I am very appreciative of his meticulous work as I live out of state. I highly recommend this company!

featured.name: Ken M.
featured.text: The information provided by Shannon was very valuable. He was very thorough and very knowledgeable. He was on time and prepared on day of inspection. I would highly recommend his services to anyone needing home inspection or septic inspection which was also nice to have 1 company do all the inspections.

featured.name: Terry P.
featured.text: Shannon did an incredibly thorough inspection of our new home. He found things that needed to be addressed before closing that saved us a significant amount of money. His report was easy to follow and the pictures helped to identify both the location and the issue. I really appreciated the reports! If you need an inspection, I highly recommend Shannon!

featured.name: Kelli W.
featured.text: Shannon was VERY VERY thorough and has great attention to detail. His reports were detailed and easy to follow. We were present at the end of the inspection and took the time to go through and explain all of his findings and concerns. We’ve moved around a lot and he’s by far the best inspector we had. He had the report back quickly so we are able to make corrections within the due diligence period. I will use him again in the future and recommend him to anyone looking for a good inspector.

featured.name: Debbie K.
featured.text: Inspect-All produced a concise and informative report. Because I'm living 900 miles from the home I'm buying in NC, the report was very helpful and I'd recommend this company to anyone who has need of their services.

featured.name: Morgan L.
featured.text: Shannan is amazing! Very quick to respond to messages and his reports are thorough. Always checks in and is readily available to answer any questions & makes sure you feel comfortable about a purchase. He is understanding and is definitely a must have when it comes to inspections. I would recommend him to anyone, whether you’re a first time buyer or not!
